uncited: Computes the cumulative distribution function (CDF) from a set of discrete weights that sum to 1, treating them as a step function.

It differs from [Max Dilation](8984-max-dilation.md) by preserving the integral mass of the distribution rather than finding local extrema, and serves as the inverse operation to [Weight-PDF Conversion](12194-weight-pdf-conversion.md).
The size on the last dimension is one greater than the input size.
- The output is a tensor with the same shape as the input, except the last dimension is expanded by 1.
